name: PFHub spinodal decomposition integration
description: evolve_composition(initial_field, parameters, times) -> array (len(times),N,N). Integrate dc/dt=M*L[f'(c)-kappa*L(c)] using the specified second-order periodic discrete Laplacian on [0,200)^2; f=rho*(c-alpha)^2*(c-beta)^2 with alpha=.3,beta=.7,rho=5,M=5,kappa=2. Score candidate wall time only when RMSE<=2e-5 versus independent DOP853, mass drift<1e-9 and discrete free energy never increases. Two fixed meshes 48 and 64, published initial condition and a phase-shift adaptation, times 1,5,20. These are explicit short-horizon, fixed-mesh adaptations, not a reproduction of PFHub equilibrium results.

name: NASICON occupation-dependent transport with exact finite-state reference
description: transport(lattice, occupancies, barrier_model, temperature_k, budget) -> exactly budget['events'] [waiting_time_seconds, directed_edge_index] pairs. For the pinned NASICON model, Na state is0 and vacancy1; Si/P framework states remain fixed. barrier_model['nasicon_lce'] supplies occupation-dependent decorated LCE sums, source fitted parameters, local environments and directed periodic hop vectors. Rates are nu*exp(-(E_KRA+direction*DeltaE_site/2)/(kBT)). Preserve particle identity, exclusion and unwrapped periodic displacement. Evaluator independently audits clocks/events and compares 1000-event mean tagged-ion MSD/(6 mean physical time) against exact propagation over1680 tagged states. Score candidate runtime*relative_standard_error^2 across64 replicas. This bounded source illustrative model does not establish bulk/asymptotic conductivity or a new validated material fit.
